name: 48342 · Pontiac, MI
findings: ZIP 48342 (Pontiac) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48342 (Pontiac) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48342 (Pontiac) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
